Neuropil and VNC surface meshes for the yakuba VNC

Source: R/data.R
yakuba_neuropil_shell.Rd

Surface meshes of the yakuba VNC in microns (yakubaum space). yakuba_neuropil_shell encloses the synaptic neuropil; yakuba_vnc_shell encloses the whole VNC including the cortex.

Usage

yakuba_neuropil_shell

yakuba_vnc_shell

Format

mesh3d objects.

An object of class mesh3d of length 2.

Details

These are the neuropil-shell and vnc-shell layers of the clio neuroglancer scene for the yakuba dataset, converted from nm to microns and decimated from ~107k to ~16k vertices (median deviation < 0.5 µm). See data-raw/yakuba_shells.R for details. Multiply by 1000 for use with nm data, e.g. from read_dyak_neurons().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(nat)
wire3d(yakuba_vnc_shell, col = "grey")
shade3d(yakuba_neuropil_shell, alpha = 0.3)
} # }
